events.title: Andrew Quilty: Afghanistan (Exhibition)
events.description: An exhibition by Australian photojournalist Andrew Quilty, exploring the history and ongoing impact of conflict in Afghanistan through powerful photographic works at the regional gallery.

events.title: WEDFest 2026 Launch Party
events.description: The launch party for WEDFest 2026, hosted by the Sunshine Coast Environment Council. Expect a social gathering to kick off a festival focused on environmental themes and community engagement.

events.title: Welcome to Your Botanic Garden
events.location: Maroochy Regional Bushland Botanic Garden, Tanawha
events.description: A guided walk and introduction to the Maroochy Regional Bushland Botanic Garden, offering an opportunity to explore the diverse plant life and learn about local ecosystems.

events.title: SILENT FILM - THE UNKNOWN - LON CHANEY & JOAN CRAWFORD - 1927
events.description: A screening of the classic 1927 silent film "The Unknown" starring Lon Chaney and Joan Crawford, presented in the historic setting of the Majestic Theatre Pomona.

events.title: Reconnecting With Nature
events.location: Maroochy Regional Bushland Botanic Garden, Tanawha
events.description: A guided experience in the botanic garden designed to foster a deeper connection with the natural environment, promoting wellbeing and mindfulness through immersive interaction with nature.

events.title: KAREN LAW & BUCKLEY'S CHANCE
events.description: A live music performance by Karen Law & Buckley's Chance, offering an intimate concert experience at the historic Majestic Theatre Pomona.
